name: Fallen Hero (10996) still casts Dismounting Blast on a mounted player
contract: Dismounting Blast (18396) knocks the target back and removes its mount aura.
Control: Ascension lists 10996 Fallen Hero as a caster of 18396, so its aggro still dismounts; this proves the harness observes the blast.
A mounted player that the creature engages must lose Brown Horse (458) and the creature must have cast 18396 at least once.
The rider faces the creature (o 0, creature along +X) so melee from the side or behind cannot daze it off the mount.

steps.label: Fallen Hero engages the mounted rider
